channel.title: Navan Badminton Club
channel.description: Welcome to Navan Badminton Club located at Claremont Stadium in Navan, Co. Meath, Ireland. Club nights every Monday and Wednesday during the season which runs from September to April. Club caters for Adults and Juveniles of all standards from beginner to advanced.

item.title: Halfway Through Summer Club! 🏸
item.description: Join us for Week 5 at Claremont Stadium tonight from 8pm to 11pm for a fun evening of badminton!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Week 4 of Our Summer Club Night
item.description: Join us at Claremont Stadium from 8pm to 11pm for rally marathons. For just €8, be part of the excitement. Whether you're experienced or new to the game, come and have fun. Grab your racket and sports gear, and join us this Wednesday night!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Roll Up, Shuttlecock Smashers! Week 3 of Summer Club
item.description: Join us for Week 3 of our Summer Club tonight from 8 PM to 11 PM at Claremont Stadium for a night full of fun, laughter, and badminton for just €8!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)
